main_text.head: IV: Hieroglyphica animata sunt eiusmodi:
main_text.p: 1. Ex volatilibus, columba est hieroglyphicum patientiae, manfuetudinis, simplicitatis, sinceritatis, & constantis fideiin coniugio, Matth.10.v.16: ciconia, turtur & hirundo, providae curae, Ier.8.v.7: aquila, regis, Ezech.17.v.3.&seqq. 5 item veræ fideiin Christi mortem intentæ, Matt.24.v.28: ala avis, providentiae Dei, Psal.91.v.4.

2. Ex aquatilibus, piscesfunt hieroglyphicum hominum, qui degunt in mari huius mundi, & inde extrahuntur in viuarium ecclesiae, Ezech.47.verf.9.10. Vnde apostoli di-10 cuntur piscatores hominum. Matt.4.verf.19. Marc.1.verf.17.

Quo pertinet etiam parabola lagenae iactae in mare, Matt.13.verf.47. Homines potentes in hoc mundo comparantur balaenis grandibus; populi & exercitus illorum, multitudini piscium adhaerentium fquamis balaenarum; 15 tractio illorum ad poenas, iniectioni hamorum in maxillas earum, Ezech.29.verf.3. & deinceps. Pfalm.74.verf.13.14. Efa.27.v.1.

3. Ex bestiis terrestribus, leo, vitulus &c. sunt hieroglyphica angelorum, Ezech.1.& 10. Apoc.4.verf.7. leo rugiens, diaboli, 1.Petr.5.v.8: ovis, est imago Christi, Efa.53.v.7: item hominis errantis, Efa.53.v.6: item hominis verè fidelis, vocemque Christi sequentis, Iohan.10.& Matth.25.v.33: hircus, quatenus sacrificium erat, fuit typus Christi, Leuit.4.9.&10. quatenus vero petulcum & foetidum est animal, 20 est imago hominis reprobi, Matt.25.v.33. leo est hieroglyphicum Dei, Thren.3.v.10. item Christi, Apoc.5.verf.5: item angeli boni, Ezech.1.&10, vel mali, 1.Petr.5.v.8. item hominis magnanimi & fortis, Gen.49.v.9. Deut.33.v.10. ite hominis crudelis, violenti, & persecutoris, Psal.22.v.22. 25 Psal.7.v.3.&10.v.9. formica, prudentiae & industriae oeconomicae, Prov.6.v.6.&seqq. Confer Prou.30.verf.24.25.26. 29.30.31: serpens, prudentiae erhicae, in omni vitâ necessariae, Matt.10.v.16.
4. In homine, caput est hieroglyphicum Christi & cuiuslibet superioritatis, 1.Cor.11.v.3.Eph.1.v.20.&seqq.cap.5. 35 v.23.

page.notes: The stray mark (*) beside line 5 is a printer's or stray mark and is left out. The line numbers in the right margin are printed line markers and are given as notes. Two lines appear as they are printed: "ite" (Deut.33.v.10 line) and "ouis" was read as "ovis". Reading of "Psal.7.v.3.&10.v.9" and "1.Petr.5.v.8" is as printed. No catchword or signature is visible.
